Sophia: Heads-up — billing variant rollout scheduled for tomorrow 10am PT. Need final signoff on: price-sheet CSV, grandfathering window logic, and telemetry labels. Drive: https://drive.redwood/price-sheets/v5. @Alan @Maya can you confirm?
Alan: Reviewed the sheet, found a rounding issue on tier 3. Will push a small fix to the sheet right now.
Maya: Noted. Vendor fees column is missing for partner SKUs — adding it (2m).
Sophia: Thanks. Once updated can someone run the invoice sim? @billingbot, please run invoice-sim for cohort B and post results.
billingbot: invoice-sim started...
billingbot: invoice-sim complete: cohort B projected delta +3.2% revenue, 14 accounts flagged as high-impact. Report: https://redwood/internal/invoice-sim/1943209876
Jules: The flagged accounts are mostly heavy-embedding customers. Suggest temporary promo for the top 7 to reduce churn risk.
Alan: Agree with Jules. Also recommend reducing cohort size from 10% -> 8% while we monitor. I'll update rollout config now:
```
rollout:
  cohort_B_pct: 0.08
  start_time: "2026-04-15T17:00:00Z"
```
Maya: Vendor fees column added and CSV exported. Updated file in drive.
Sophia: OK — gating final deploy on three confirmations: (1) Alan updates config, (2) Maya confirms CSV export, (3) Jules + accounting sign off on promo. If we have all by 9am PT I'll proceed.
Alan: Config updated and pushed. :thumbsup:
Jules: I'll prepare promo copy and loop accounting. Adding @Priya-finance.
Priya-finance: Quick check — promo budget approved up to $12k. Accounting gives green light.
Sophia: All green. Proceeding with scheduled rollout; will post 1-hour post-deploy metrics in #finance.
